This repository is generated from
[`startdownnotez404/monorepo` → `templates/playground3-app`](https://github.com/startdownnotez404/monorepo/tree/dev/templates/playground3-app)
and overwritten on every sync, so pull requests here are not merged.

Please open your change against the monorepo instead. To build your own app,
use **Use this template** or `npx degit startdownnotez404/playground3-app-template my-app`.
